candidate: Glanville fritillary (Melitaea cinxia), Aland metapopulation, annual autumn surveys

scientific_anchor.dataset_title: M. cinxia and C. melitaearum in the Åland metapopulation system
scientific_anchor.published_scope: 1993-2017; circa 4000 dry-meadow habitat patches; autumn patch surveys plus spring revisits
scientific_anchor.window_reason: A published analysis of this public metapopulation explicitly restricts to 2000-2017 after the comprehensive 1998-1999 habitat remapping; freeze this window before any locality-visit outcome rows are opened.
scientific_anchor.source_process_claim: conditional internal-source metapopulation explanation within the published Aland patch registry; no claim that biological immigration from outside the declared source universe is impossible

record_selection_rule: Using metadata only, select the unique non-deprecated published Fairdata version of the exact dataset title that covers 1993-2017 and exposes separately identifiable Patch and Locality-visit resources. If version relations do not make one record uniquely current, stop rather than choose using file contents.

required_resource_roles.patch_registry: one row per habitat patch, location and geometry; response-independent
required_resource_roles.locality_visit: one row per patch-survey combination; contains Melitaea cinxia nest abundance/occupancy and therefore remains forbidden at this stage
required_resource_roles.documentation: field definitions sufficient to freeze physical schemas, survey/existence semantics, and prospective missing-row admissibility before locality-visit rows are opened
